outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Probate page
outreach_draft.body:
Hi David,

I was looking through Gibson Herod Law’s site and noticed Probate and Probate Litigation is presented on the same general Practice Areas page as commercial transactions, asset recovery, business litigation, appeals, and other business-focused work. A probate client arriving after a death or family dispute has a very different set of questions and priorities from a commercial client.

A focused Probate page could give that visitor a clearer journey—what matters you handle, who you represent, what the process looks like, and when to reach out—without asking them to navigate the broader commercial conversation. It can also give Google a more specific service context and make the site easier for AI systems to understand.

I’d use Probate for the first mockup because it is the clearest distinct client journey on the shared page.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
